author: iEJH
content: Plan: Implement M5 in 7 separate commits: (1) Zustand store with Layer 1 params + presets, (2) Control panel UI with sliders/toggles/dropdowns, (3) Preset selector with 7 presets, (4) Layer toggle for 12+ data layers, (5) IndexedDB persistence via idb, (6) PNG export with multiple projections, (7) SVG + GeoJSON/TopoJSON exports. Key files: src/store/appStore.ts, src/components/ControlPanel.tsx, src/components/LayerToggle.tsx, src/persistence/idb.ts, src/export/{png,svg,geojson}.ts
